decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to use enchantments to generate card draw and ramp, while also setting up a powerful combo using Opalescence and Enchantress effects. By constantly drawing cards with Enchantress effects and manipulating the top of the deck with cards like Mirri's Guile and Sylvan Library, the deck aims to find its combo pieces like Opalescence and Replenish to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures-turned-enchantments. The deck also includes some support cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing for removal and protection.

The deck focuses on aggressively dealing damage to the opponent using efficient low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. The goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero by overwhelming them with a steady stream of burn spells and hasty creatures. It aims to apply constant pressure and force the opponent to react defensively, while also being able to finish them off with powerful finishers like Ball Lightning and Fireblast. The deck prioritizes speed and consistency in order to win before the opponent can stabilize.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck aims to control the game with targeted discard spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, while also pressuring the opponent with creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Knight of Stromgald. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Smother and Snuff Out to handle problematic creatures. The inclusion of Mishra's Factory provides additional creature threats while Wasteland disrupts the opponent's mana base. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and disruption to quickly close out games.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and card draw. The goal is to quickly deploy the Dreadnought, then protect it with Stifle to prevent its sacrifice ability from triggering. The deck includes card selection tools like Opt and Impulse to find the combo pieces efficiently, while also having disruptive elements like Counterspell and Chain of Vapor to handle opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to win through a fast and resilient combo strategy.

The deck focuses on milling itself with cards like Hermit Druid and graveyard manipulation to assemble combo pieces in the graveyard. It uses cards like Karmic Guide and Animate Dead to bring back key creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath or Triskelion for the win. Survival of the Fittest helps tutor for combo pieces while also filling the graveyard. The deck also has a disruption package with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to win through a creature combo or by overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain board presence and prevent the opponent from establishing a strong board state. The inclusion of Standstill helps to further slow down the game while also allowing for card advantage. The deck also includes land destruction elements with cards like Dust Bowl and Mishra's Factory to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the goal is to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and attrition.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on early game pressure and disruption to quickly deplete the opponent's resources and life total. By utilizing efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade, along with disruptive spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, the deck aims to control the game tempo. The inclusion of removal spells like Diabolic Edict and Snuff Out helps to deal with opposing threats, while cards like Graveborn Muse and Phyrexian Arena provide card advantage to ensure a steady stream of threats. The deck also includes Mishra's Factory and Wasteland to provide additional utility and board control.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption and removal spells, while slowly winning the game through incremental damage and resource denial. By using cards like Diabolic Edict, Duress, and The Rack, it aims to control the pace of the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. With a combination of efficient threats like Hypnotic Specter and Ravenous Rats, as well as utility lands like Wasteland and Mishra's Factory, this deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until it secures victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the card Balancing Act to reset the board and gain advantage over the opponent. By combining mana acceleration with powerful draw spells and recursion, the deck aims to set up a game-winning play with Roar of the Wurm or Burning Wish. The inclusion of Orim's Chant and Chain of Vapor helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The land base is carefully constructed to provide the necessary colors and mana sources for the spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly by playing multiple mana-producing Elves and utilizing cards like Gaea's Cradle. By generating a large amount of mana, the deck aims to efficiently play cards like Deranged Hermit and Elvish Champion to apply pressure on opponents. The inclusion of cards like Survival of the Fittest and Natural Order also allow for efficient creature tutoring and powerful creature plays. Additionally, cards like Tangle Wire and Winter Orb can disrupt opponents' game plans, giving the Elves deck an advantage in controlling the game tempo.

The deck focuses on utilizing enchantments to establish a powerful board presence and generate card advantage. It utilizes Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence to draw cards whenever enchantments enter the battlefield. The deck generates mana quickly with Wild Growth and Exploration, while also utilizing Sterling Grove for protection and tutoring. The combo of Opalescence and Parallax Wave allows for controlling the board and dealing with opponents' threats. Replenish can bring back multiple enchantments from the graveyard, providing a powerful late-game advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through card advantage and powerful enchantment synergies.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By playing efficient threats like Hypnotic Specter and Ravenous Rats, alongside utility creatures like Withered Wretch and Nantuko Shade, the deck aims to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The inclusion of removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict also helps to clear the way for the deck's creatures to attack. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast and proactive game plan to defeat the opponent quickly.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of disruptive spells and land destruction while utilizing Oath of Druids as a win condition. It aims to ramp up mana quickly with Mox Diamond and efficient land cards, while using cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Terravore serves as a powerful threat that can quickly close out the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate to handle opposing threats. Additionally, Sylvan Library helps with card selection and draw power.

The deck focuses on setting up a lock with Stasis to prevent opponents from untapping their lands, while utilizing various counterspells and card draw to protect the combo and find key pieces. It also includes disruptive elements like Black Vise and Powder Keg to pressure opponents and disrupt their game plan. The goal is to stall the game until the player can establish a winning condition, such as decking the opponent with Brain Freeze or overwhelming them with counter magic and card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore while disrupting the opponent's strategy with Meddling Mage and Armageddon. The deck also utilizes ramp and land destruction to keep the opponent off balance, enabling the aggressive creatures to deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of Weathered Wayfarer and Sylvan Library helps with card advantage and consistency. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, disruption, and efficient creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore while disrupting opponents with Mox Diamond and Armageddon. It also utilizes cards like Sylvan Library and Weathered Wayfarer to maintain card advantage and land destruction, ultimately aiming to overwhelm opponents with a mix of creature pressure and resource denial. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's mana base to gain a significant advantage in the game.
